source_chain: Fpa CLI Refresh awaits Promise.all([Aca.refetch(), Ica.mutateAsync()]); isLoading is Aca.isLoading || Ica.isPending.
Aca uses Cca -> Eca -> check_codex_auth, and reads the shared account through OEr.
Ica uses Sca -> Kb.getCodexAuthInfo; Sca publishes accountInfo through PEr only when error is undefined.
PEr -> T7t assigns the account value including undefined; kPt/x7t expose the store to OEr/m9r.
The response schema permits omitted accountInfo and error; getCodexAuthInfo forwards them as undefined.
Fpa passes absent accountInfo into t$i. Pending refresh then renders Checking login status... despite a previous successful signed-out response.
negative_cases: Nonnull accountInfo suppresses t$i checking branch; an empty object differs from absent accountInfo.
An error string stops Sca from clearing the last account.
Current initial loading already shows checking. The candidate requires a successful first load in the same mount.
ChatGPT and API-key modes are outside this source contract and remain unchanged.
current_main_chain: AgentsPage mounts CodexTab without a refresh-dependent key.
CodexTab -> useAgentStatus -> agentStatusLoader retains nonnull ProviderStatus after first successful signed-out status load.
Refresh sets loading true until both inert responses settle; loading && !provider suppresses checking on the second load.
StatusLine -> AuthStatus already preserves Connected when authenticated is true.
